summary.text: Mary Belk is a Democratic state representative from North Carolina House District 88 who has served since 2017 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is the House Democratic Joint Caucus Chair and represents Mecklenburg County.

paragraphs.text: Belk attended Garinger High School and, in the 1970s, worked in insurance adjustment.
She later owned a family printing business with her husband, Ralph, and after retiring from it they formed New River Retreat Properties, a vacation rental investment firm.
She earned a degree in political science from the University of North Carolina at Charlotte in 2006.
Her community involvement has included serving on the board of the Dilworth Community Development Association and the Charlotte Catholic Foundation.
Belk assumed office in the North Carolina House on January 1, 2017, succeeding Rob Bryan.
The General Assembly's website lists her as House Democratic Joint Caucus Chair, in her fifth House term.
In the 2025-2026 session she is a member of the Appropriations, Election Law, Health, Regulatory Reform and Transportation committees and the Appropriations subcommittee on Transportation.
